name: trickle-lite
description: See the runtime type of every value in your TypeScript, live, and where it drifts from the declared type.

trickleLite.hints.enabled.description: Show the observed runtime type of each value inline.

trickleLite.hints.annotated.description: Also show inline hints where the source already declares a type (drifts are always shown).

trickleLite.check.enabled.description: Re-check runtime types against declared types when observations change or a file is saved.

trickleLite.diagnostics.undeclaredProper.description: Report runtime objects that carry properties their declared type does not mention (structural typing allows this, so it is off by default).

trickleLite.diagnostics.declaredAny.description: Mark values declared as `any` with the type they actually had (as a hint).
